title: A new PBW basis for the alternating central extension of the $q$-Onsager algebra
summary: We establish a new PBW basis for $\mathcal A_q$, the alternating central extension of the $q$-Onsager algebra. Terwilliger showed that the alternating generators form a PBW basis in the block order $\mathcal G<\mathcal W^-<\mathcal W^+<\widetilde{\mathcal G}$. We prove that they also form a PBW basis in the different block order $\mathcal W^-<\mathcal G<\widetilde{\mathcal G}<\mathcal W^+$.
